policy: Use the established worst + 3 sample SDs, rounded outward to three decimals, on 30 development streams.
Only /z/ upper-ratio and, if separately justified by trace and development spread, /n/ absolute-gap are eligible for changed limits. Keep global defaults and every other phone bound unchanged.
Check every common phoneme against its applicable limits, not only the worst raw metric.
Freeze exact proposed limits and code before opening the ten previously reserved confirmation streams. Do not adjust to their results.
Retain total variation 1.78%, minimum ratio .918, zero coverage/loss requirements, gate seed42 and sample size.

For /n/, trace construction-to-output changes and selected-root lengths on the same first ten development streams used in the prior investigation; distinguish direct phone deletion from selection/composition shifts.
